Evidence and decisions

Quick readMore contextTechnical detail

How can a partnership show why it made a decision, and revise it when evidence changes?

My example

When AI helps with research, someone later has to ask: what evidence supports this claim, what is still uncertain, and what was this action allowed to do? GKOS is my developing approach to keeping those links.

Provenance lets people inspect a claim. It does not make the claim true.

in development

A practical next step

Test one evidence record that connects a claim, its sources, review, limits, and next decision.

Progress would mean: A new reviewer can trace the claim to evidence and explain what changed after review.

Agenda connection: Resource Guide, p. 13. Suggested breakout: Track B · Ecosystem best practices. Track placement and proposals are my contributions; the handouts provide the discussion context.

Participant proposals for the Widener-led, NSF-funded convening. Project examples include documented results, work in development, and proposed pilots.
